core_obligations: First assertion: cite chow-lemma-rational-function part (6); restate the graph closure computation div_W(f) = [W'_0]_k - [W'_inf]_k.
Second assertion: W' in X x P1 dominating P1, W its image in X; case dim(W) = k gives W' = W x P1 and the difference is zero.
Case dim(W) = k + 1: W' -> W generically finite (birational subcase delegated to the cited lemma in the footnote); f = projection to P1 viewed in C(W')^*, g = Nm(f) in C(W)^*.
Cited proper-pushforward-alteration lemma gives div_W(g) = pr_{X,*} div_{W'}(f); combine with the graph formula to conclude.
